item.title: My Movie List
item.description:
Here is my list of movies.

The "Status" column may contain:

  • The date when I watched the movie
  • "(?)" if I watched the movie before mid-2015, when I began keeping track, or if I forgot to record the date at the time of watching it.
  • "Not yet" if I intend to watch the movie but have not watched it yet.

The "Rank" column is one of the following:

  • 💛 Personal favorite. Usually, (but not always,) a must-watch.
  • ⭐ Must-watch.
  • 👍 OK to watch.
  • 🤷 Meh.
  • 👎 Do not watch.
  • 🎦 Not sure / do not remember / not watched.

Please note that the remarks that I have written for each movie reflect the impression I was left with at the time of watching that movie, which may have been quite a long time ago. So, these remarks may not be what I would have written if I had watched that movie today. (Some of these movies I even watched on Greek Public TV in the 1980s; that's like in a previous life.)

On several occasions I mention the Truffaut effect; here is some information about it: Google search - Truffaut effect

Cover image: my-movie-list by michael.gr, based on "Film" by Bonnie Duffley from The Noun Project

2019 Midway IMDb 2020-08-08 👍 Well done. Some scenes have some strange artistic choice about light, dialog, etc. Has at least one scene that is forever scarring.
2019 The Irishman IMDb 2020-04-11 🤷 Well made, but not captivating enough.
2019 The Report IMDb 2020-01-25 ⭐ A.K.A. The Torture Report - A movie, but also a documentary. Well done. Good soundtrack, too. Requires patience and interest in the subject.
2019 The Wolf's Call IMDb 2020-06-22 ⭐ (Le chant du Loup) Very good. Almost excellent.
2020 Greyhound IMDb 2020-07-28 ⭐ Very good.
2020 Sonic The Hedgehog IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2021 Don't Look Up IMDb 2023-12-22 ⭐ Quite good. There are some impossibilities in the scenario, but it is okay, the allegory is obvious. It is perhaps the most predictable movie ever, but then again, this is meant to show that it is just as predictable in real life.
2021 Dune: Part One IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2021 Finch IMDb 2025-08-10 👍 Slightly anti-climactic, but overall quite decent.
2021 No Time to Die IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2021 West Side Story IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2022 All Quiet on the Western Front IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2022 Top Gun Maverick IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2023 Crater IMDb 2025-09-13 👍 Nice teenager movie. Watched it with my son.
2023 Indiana Jones and the dial of Destiny IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2023 John Wick: Chapter 4 IMDb (?) 👍 Entertaining.
2023 Killers of the Flower Moon IMDb Not yet. 🎦
2023 Napoleon IMDb Not yet. 🎦 Dan Snow says it is not historically accurate.
2023 Oppenheimer IMDb 2023-07-20 👍 Quite good. The "patriotic crowd" scene was well done, though I think the movie needed more of that. Due to unknown reasons, the female characters are directed in a misogynistic way.
2023 Plane IMDb 2024-12-30 👍 Mediocre acting, ultra-violence, entertaining.
2023 The Creator IMDb 2026-07-25 👍 Very impressive visuals, some brilliant and some not-so-brilliant art, mediocre scenario and story-telling, some annoying unlikely or supernatural technology, no message to take home. The music in the truck escaping from the barn was Deep Purple - Child in Time, kudos for that.
